data.one_liner: A request router for the shelf web-framework with support for URL parameters and nested routers.
data.what_it_does: It matches incoming HTTP requests to handlers using route patterns. It supports URL parameters, nested routers, and can be used with source annotations via shelf_router_generator.
use_when: You are building a web application or API in Dart using the shelf framework
You need URL parameters and nested routing capabilities for your server
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application UI and need screen navigation
You are not using the shelf package for your backend
strengths: Convenient routing matching for shelf web applications
Supports nested routers and URL parameters
Prefix Trie filter optimization for static path segments
weaknesses: Requires manual handler mapping unless using the separate generator package
data.setup_notes: Add shelf and shelf_router to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.
